name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
changes.summary: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

changes.title: Ukrainian Drone Mastermind, Fired by Kyiv, Will Advise Italy’s Defense Chief
changes.summary: The appointment of Mykhailo Fedorov, a Ukrainian former defense minister, showed how other militaries are racing to adapt to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.

changes.title: Daily fragment: Donald Trump
changes.summary: US president Donald Trump meets with Russian president Vladimir Putin in Alaska, the first such summit since the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

changes.title: Putin Visits Islands Seized From Japan in World War II, Angering Tokyo
changes.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan has been a public critic of Mr. Putin, who has denounced her country’s sanctions against Russia over the Ukraine war.

changes.title: By sky and sea, Ukraine's drone strikes challenge Russia's grip on Crimea
changes.summary: Russia maintained an iron grip on Crimea since seizing it from Ukraine in 2014. Many Russian civilians go there to enjoy the beaches. But now Ukraine is hitting Crimea hard, upending daily life. (Image credit: Igor Ivanko).

changes.title: Russian Blockade of Major Ukrainian Ports Threatens Global Grain Supplies
changes.summary: The deadly strikes are part of a long-running maritime battle with Ukraine and echo battles over other key shipping routes around the world.

changes.title: Russian attacks kill 10 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy says Moscow is getting more North Korean missiles
changes.summary: Russia attacked Ukrainian cities with missiles, drones and glide bombs Tuesday, killing at least 10 civilians, officials said, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Moscow is getting new military help from North Korea for its more than 4-year-old invasion.

changes.title: Russian Civilian Deaths Are Growing Rapidly as Ukraine Expands Its Air War
changes.summary: The higher tempo of Ukrainian strikes has fueled discontent among Russians, but it is far from clear that it will change the Kremlin’s calculus about the war.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Ukraine's drone forces could strike seven times more targets in Crimea if Western funding came faster, according to the commander leading Ukraine's drone war.
